results.evidence: InviteRow: `isExistingMember = existingMemberEmails.has(...)`; className adds ' errored' and renders `<div className="text-danger ...">This email already belongs to a member...`. InviteRow is used in the settings dialog.
existingMemberEmails selector includes `user?.email` alongside member emails, so own email is flagged the same way.

canSubmit becomes false with existing-member emails, but no reason text about removing existing members is added to any submit control. Per-row Submit button is only `disabled={!isEmail(...)}`, not disabled for existing-member rows.
Selector maps emails with `.trim().toLowerCase()` and the row and canSubmit lookups use `target_email.trim().toLowerCase()`.
`afterMount(({ actions }) => { actions.ensureAllMembersLoaded() })` fetches members; the selector adds `user?.email` even when members is null (`members ?? []`).

validate_target_email runs during serializer validation for every row (bulk serializer with many=True validates all before saving), and raises ValidationError for existing members, so no invites are created. The summary says this runs before any save.
validate_target_email raises `exceptions.ValidationError(..., code="already_member")`. Being a field validator, it is attributed to target_email.
No change to error-tracking/exception capture on the frontend or backend. The author admits they did not confirm that reports stop.
No code refreshes members on a server rejection; there is no listener on inviteTeamMembersFailure that reloads members.

result:
An invite to an existing member, or to yourself, is now flagged in the row before you submit. The backend also rejects a batch containing one before anything is created or emailed. I haven't run any tests, typecheck or typegen, per your instructions.

**Backend** (`posthog/api/organization_invite.py`)
- The existing-member check moved into `validate_target_email`, which DRF runs for every row before any save. A batch with a member in row three is now rejected with a 400 (`code="already_member"`) before invites one and two are created or emailed.
- I kept the old check in `create()` as a fallback.
- `ValidationError` is an `APIException`, and `exception_reporting` in `posthog/exceptions.py` skips those. I found no capture call on this path in the code, so I don't know where the error-tracking noise you're seeing comes from. Validation now fails earlier, but I didn't confirm it stops the reports.

**Frontend**
- `inviteLogic.ts` now loads the organization's members and adds an `existingMemberEmails` selector. It holds the lowercased member emails plus your own.
- `canSubmit` is false while any row's email is in that set.
- `InviteRow` in `InviteModal.tsx` shows an error state and the message "This email already belongs to a member of your organization." under the field. The onboarding step uses the same row and logic, so it gets the same behaviour.

**Test**: `test_bulk_invite_with_existing_member_creates_no_invites` sends two valid rows plus the inviter's own email. It expects a 400, no invites created and no mail sent.

I edited the generated type blocks in `inviteLogic.ts` by hand and added `existingMemberEmails` to `inviteLogicValues`, but I didn't add `user` there. The typegen block may need a regen.
